adversarial.description: Not among contract 094's 13 listed verification commands. External Anchor Rule: Mode B already probed type-rejection on the work-packet schema, so this probe deliberately picked a DIFFERENT angle -- schema/qa_verdict.schema.json's anyOf's LESS-TRAVELLED legacy branch (features 000-016 shape), rather than re-probing the evolved branch or work-packet again. Expectation was anchored on reading BOTH anyOf branches' `required` arrays first (legacy: feature_id/verdict/executed_at/checks/required_fixes; evolved: feature_id/qa_pass/checks_run/checks_passed/adversarial/evidence_files/issues/unsupported_claims/missing_acceptance_coverage/required_fixes/final_verdict), establishing that a pure legacy-shaped instance structurally cannot satisfy the evolved branch's required array (it carries none of evolved's nine exclusive required keys), so the probe's overall-anyOf verdict is decided by the legacy branch alone -- a clean, unambiguous design immune to the anyOf's own 'failing one branch may still pass the other' semantics. Two structurally identical legacy-shaped instances were constructed: Probe A carries dod_ref as a STRING ('standard/definition_of_done.md') and Probe B carries dod_ref as an OBJECT ({'path': 'x'}), otherwise identical.
adversarial.result: PASS -- Probe A (string dod_ref) validates successfully against schema/qa_verdict.schema.json's overall anyOf, via the legacy branch. Probe B (object dod_ref) is REJECTED by the overall anyOf: it fails the legacy branch on the dod_ref type:string constraint, and independently fails the evolved branch's required array (missing qa_pass/checks_run/checks_passed/adversarial/evidence_files/issues/unsupported_claims/missing_acceptance_coverage/final_verdict), so there is no anyOf loophole letting a malformed (non-string) dod_ref slip through via the other branch. jsonschema.ValidationError confirms: 'is not valid under any of the given schemas'. Confirms the new dod_ref key is genuinely type-enforced on both anyOf branches, not merely present as an unvalidated additionalProperties passthrough.
